source_title: DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline - FreeJobAlert.Com
source_excerpt:
The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is hiring one Cooperative Intern for Diu District for one year only. The bank is doing this under NABARD's directions. Applicants need an MBA or equivalent in Marketing, Cooperative, Agri Business or Rural Development Management and must be 21 to 30 years old. The internship pays a consolidated Rs.25,000 a month. Send your bio-data on plain paper so that it reaches the bank's Head Office in Nani Daman by 05:00 PM on 23 November 2026.
DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Recruitment 2026 Overview
The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.
The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is a state co-operative bank licensed by the RBI (Licence No. Dos. RO (AH). REG/LIC.S-2187/04.36.000/2023-24 dated 07 March 2024). Its Head Office is in Dilip Nagar, Nani Daman, and its Administration Department issued this notice. You can reach that department on 0260 2255984 and 2255985, or by email at [email protected] . The internship is part of NABARD's scheme for engaging Cooperative Interns to strengthen cooperatives. The National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) runs the scheme, NABARD monitors it and state co-operative banks carry it out.
DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Vacancy Details 2026
The bank pays TA/DA from its own funds. The Rs.25,000 remuneration is reimbursed from the Cooperative Education Fund of the Ministry of Cooperation through NCDC.
DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Eligibility 2026
You must be at least 21 years old and no older than 30.
MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management / Cooperative Management / Agri Business Management / Rural Development Management.
The bank asks candidates to read the full eligibility criteria and essential requirements in NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024, which comes with the official notification, before applying.
Work with PACS and other primary cooperatives and guide them in carrying out the initiatives of the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India.
Solve day-to-day problems PACS face with computerisation, business plans, projects, financing and various approvals.
Prepare and share a weekly status report on these initiatives, in coordination with the DCCB/StCB.
The scheme aims to take the cooperative movement down to the grassroots. It also lets professional graduates learn how cooperatives work in practice and builds a pool of experienced cooperative professionals.
This is purely an internship programme for one year only. NCDC funds it, and the bank carries no liability.
It is not an appointment or employment and does not promise one. No intern has any right or claim to a job with the bank because of this internship.
The internship is full-time. The intern must keep the bank's working hours.
The bank may post or transfer interns according to its functional needs.
Interns get 10 days of Casual Leave for the year and no other leave. Any other leave is treated as "Leave without remuneration". The bank's holidays may apply to interns.
The internship may end at any time, with no financial benefit, if performance is not satisfactory or the intern is absent without the bank's permission. The bank may also end it at any time without giving a reason.
Interns must keep all documents, reports and information confidential. Breaking this rule has legal consequences.
Interns may not deal with or represent the bank to print, electronic or social media. They may not post their work on social media without express permission from the competent authority.
Interns must follow the rules and regulations of the bank and behave professionally with the bank and the public.
How to Apply for DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Recruitment 2026
Read the official notification and NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024 on the bank's website .
Write your application on plain paper with your complete bio-data.
Address it to: The General Manager (ADM), The Daman & Diu State Cooperative Bank Ltd., Head Office- H. No. 14/54, 1st Floor, Dilipnagar, Nani Daman- 396210.
Make sure it reaches the Head Office by 05:00 PM on 23 November 2026. Applications that arrive after that will be rejected outright.
Self-attested copies of certificates showing your age, eligibility, educational qualification and experience
A recent coloured passport-size photograph
Any updates on this recruitment will be posted on the bank's website.
Have questions about eligibility , dates , or vacancies ? Found incorrect information ? The FreeJobAlert team is here to help.

One. The intern will work in Diu District for one year.
